<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Introduction</strong></h2>



<p><a href="https://listing.help/dexscreener/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">DexScreener</a> automatically indexes supported DEX pools, but visibility depends on more than just creating a pair. Projects need a valid liquidity pool, verified contract data, accurate metadata, official links, healthy trading activity, and clean token information so users can find and trust the right pair.</p>



<p>This guide explains the DexScreener listing requirements and criteria in 2026, including liquidity, metadata, verification, supported DEXs, visibility factors, and common mistakes to avoid.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>What Are the DexScreener Listing Requirements?</strong></h2>



<p>To appear correctly and look trustworthy, a token needs a supported DEX pool, enough liquidity, verified contract data, accurate metadata, official project links, and clean trading information.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>1) Supported Networks and DEXs</strong></h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>DexScreener tracks <strong>over 80 DEXs</strong> across <strong>25+ blockchains</strong>, including:<br>
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Ethereum (Uniswap, SushiSwap)<br></li>



<li>BNB Chain (PancakeSwap, BabyDogeSwap)<br></li>



<li>Solana (Raydium, Orca)<br></li>



<li>Polygon (QuickSwap)<br></li>



<li>Arbitrum & Optimism (Camelot, Velodrome)<br></li>
</ul>
</li>



<li>Your token must be <strong>live on a supported DEX</strong> with a valid liquidity pool.<br></li>
</ul>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>2) Smart-Contract Verification</strong></h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Verify your contract on a public explorer (Etherscan, BscScan, Solscan, etc.).<br></li>



<li>Ensure <a href="https://listing.help/what-are-smart-contracts-on-blockchain/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">contract</a> name, symbol, and decimals are correctly displayed.<br></li>



<li>Publish token metadata (logo, website, and social links) via your token’s JSON file or explorer profile.<br></li>



<li>Avoid using proxy contracts with hidden admin controls or taxes that alter price feeds.<br></li>
</ul>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>3) Liquidity Pool and Trading Data</strong></h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Pools must have at least <strong>$10,000–$20,000</strong> in initial liquidity to appear reliably.<br></li>



<li>Trades, volume, and price updates must broadcast correctly through the DEX’s smart-contract logs.<br></li>



<li>Inactive or illiquid pools may be excluded from rankings.<br><br>For a deeper breakdown of launch costs and visibility work, see our <a href="https://listing.help/dexscreener-listing-cost/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">DexScreener listing cost guide</a>.<br><br>If you only want to understand whether DexScreener charges an official fee, read our <a href="https://listing.help/dexscreener-listing-fee/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">DexScreener listing fee</a> overview.</li>
</ul>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>4) Token Metadata Submission</strong></h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Projects can submit token information via the official DexScreener <strong>Verification Form</strong> or by adding metadata to supported DEX APIs.<br></li>



<li>Required fields include:<br>
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Contract address<br></li>



<li>Token name and symbol<br></li>



<li>Website and logo (512×512 PNG)<br></li>



<li>Links to official social channels<br></li>



<li>Verified pool address(es)<br></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>5) Compliance and Authenticity</strong></h3>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Tokens flagged for scams, honeypots, or liquidity rugpulls are removed automatically.<br></li>



<li>DexScreener cross-checks project data with explorers and DEX APIs for safety.<br></li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>DexScreener Listing Criteria Explained</strong></h2>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1536" height="1024" src="https://listing.help/wp-content/uploads/547-Group.png" alt="" class="wp-image-4742" srcset="https://listing.help/wp-content/uploads/547-Group.png 1536w, https://listing.help/wp-content/uploads/547-Group-768x512.png 768w" sizes="(max-width: 1536px) 100vw, 1536px"></figure>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Automatic Indexing</strong></h3>



<p>If your token is live on a supported DEX, it will <strong>automatically appear</strong> on DexScreener once liquidity and transaction data are detected.<br>However, unverified tokens show limited information until metadata is submitted.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Verified Token Profiles</strong></h3>



<p>Verified listings display:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Official logo, website, and description<br></li>



<li>Verified contract address<br></li>



<li>Primary trading pairs and liquidity data<br></li>



<li>Cross-chain tracking if applicable<br>Projects can apply for verification to distinguish their token from clones or scams.<br></li>
</ul>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Liquidity and Volume Ranking</strong></h3>



<p>Tokens with stronger liquidity and active trading gain higher visibility. To achieve this, we recommend partnering with a professional <a href="https://listing.help/market-making/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">market maker</a> to ensure robust liquidity and consistent trading activity.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Cross-Chain Support</strong></h3>



<p>DexScreener automatically aggregates liquidity from all DEXs where your token is deployed, offering unified tracking for multichain tokens.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>How to Get Listed on DexScreener in 202</strong>6</h2>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img decoding="async" width="1536" height="1024" src="https://listing.help/wp-content/uploads/b8083e13-9502-49f5-95a5-3c713f1cf690.png" alt="" class="wp-image-4768" srcset="https://listing.help/wp-content/uploads/b8083e13-9502-49f5-95a5-3c713f1cf690.png 1536w, https://listing.help/wp-content/uploads/b8083e13-9502-49f5-95a5-3c713f1cf690-768x512.png 768w" sizes="(max-width: 1536px) 100vw, 1536px"></figure>



<ol class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Deploy and Verify Your Token</strong><strong><br></strong>Deploy your token on a supported blockchain and verify the contract via a public explorer.<br></li>



<li><strong>Create a Liquidity Pool</strong><strong><br></strong>Add your token pair (e.g., TOKEN/USDT or TOKEN/WETH) on a supported DEX such as Uniswap, PancakeSwap, or Raydium.<br></li>



<li><strong>Confirm Visibility</strong><strong><br></strong> Within 10–30 minutes after the first transaction, check DexScreener for your pair.<br>If it doesn’t appear, verify that your DEX is supported and that trading activity exists.<br></li>



<li><strong>Submit Metadata for Verification</strong><strong><br></strong>Fill out the official <strong>DexScreener Token Verification Form</strong> on their website to display your logo, links, and project details.<br></li>



<li><strong>Monitor and Maintain Data</strong><strong><br></strong>Update your metadata when you launch new pools or cross-chain versions.<br></li>
</ol>



<p>For detailed instructions on how to list on DexScreener, consult our <a href="https://listing.help/how-to-list-token-or-coin-on-dexscreener/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">comprehensive guide</a>.<br></p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Professional Support with Listing.Help</strong></h2>



<p>Although DexScreener listings are automated, a professional presence still requires accurate setup. <a href="https://listing.help/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Listing.Help</a> helps projects prepare pool links, verify contracts, submit correct metadata, improve visibility, coordinate <a href="https://listing.help/marketing/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">post-launch marketing</a>, and make sure liquidity is properly indexed.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Key Factors That Increase Visibility</strong></h2>



<ol class="wp-block-list">
<li>Verified contract and pool address.<br></li>



<li>Minimum $10,000+ liquidity in main trading pair.<br></li>



<li>Accurate metadata with logo and website.<br></li>



<li>Verified DEX integration (PancakeSwap, Uniswap, etc.).<br></li>



<li>Transparent project communication and no proxy contracts.<br></li>
</ol>



<p>For additional visibility and trust signals on DEX tracking platforms, see our <a href="https://listing.help/how-to-get-listed-on-dextools/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">DEXTools listing guide</a>.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Common Mistakes to Avoid</strong></h2>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Unverified or fake pool contracts.<br></li>



<li>Liquidity below minimum threshold.<br></li>



<li>Wrong or missing token metadata.<br></li>



<li>Use of taxable tokens that distort prices.<br></li>



<li>Submitting multiple duplicate pools without merging.</li>
</ul>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Conclusion</strong></h2>



<p>DexScreener is essential for token visibility within the DeFi ecosystem.<br>Listing success depends on verified smart contracts, accurate metadata, and healthy liquidity.<br>Many teams rely on Listing.Help to navigate the verification process, ensuring their tokens are accurately listed, rank higher in searches, and gain visibility on trending dashboards.</p>
